purpose: Check exact algebra and degeneracies before any task or native-circuit execution; no method selected.

profiles.A: E=rho_phi rank one; after successful class effect read V on E rho E / p; pool with native alpha.
profiles.B: Unregularized real weak-value n/p, n=Re Tr(E V rho); retain native alpha=(p+EPS)/sum(p+EPS).
profiles.C_identity_only: Algebraic interpretation of n/(p+EPS) under the same alpha. This is a different function from B, not a retuning or recovery of B.
profiles.D: Same-state expectation u=Tr(V rho), pooled with native alpha. Check density first/second moments and separate router/value dephasing.

dense_checks: Rank-one postselected-state collapse and pooled constant
Regularized signed-numerator pooling equals a first-density-moment ratio
Same-state observable pooling equals the two-copy second moment plus EPS first moment
Independent real Hermitian coordinates reproduce direct matrix traces
Observable range and Cauchy-Schwarz numerator bound

edge_checks.weak_value_anchor: rho=|0><0|, E=|0><0|, V=X; anchor probability=1 and numerator=0
edge_checks.same_density_ensembles: X plus/minus versus Z zero/one, E=|+><+|, V=X
edge_checks.independent_exact_checks: Fraction matrix multiplication on fixed 2x2 rational states/effects; exact same-density contrast and singularity table

decision_gate: Collapse or EPS pole rejects that specified profile. A nondegenerate D component is not a selected task method: task information, substantive novelty, fair controls and new theory remain unproved. Exact classical representation is a control, not a simulability veto.
scope_limit: Random density matrices and explicit qubit examples are algebra checks, not task evidence or certified reachable ports of the native ansatz.
